apiKey.description: The Checkly API key. Can also be set using the `CHECKLY_API_KEY` environment variable.

apiUrl.description: The Checkly API URL, an http or https URL with a host and without a query or fragment. Defaults to `https://api.checklyhq.com`. Can also be set using the `CHECKLY_API_URL` environment variable.

url.description: The URL to send the webhook request to.

webhookSecret.description: A secret to sign webhook requests with. When set, Checkly sends an HMAC-SHA256 signature of the request body, keyed with this secret, in the `x-checkly-signature` header.

webhookType.description: Type of the webhook. Possible values are `WEBHOOK_CORALOGIX`, `WEBHOOK_DISCORD`, `WEBHOOK_FIREHYDRANT`, `WEBHOOK_GITLAB_ALERT`, `WEBHOOK_ILERT`, `WEBHOOK_INCIDENTIO`, `WEBHOOK_MSTEAMS`, `WEBHOOK_ROOTLY`, `WEBHOOK_SPIKESH`, `WEBHOOK_SPLUNK` and `WEBHOOK_TELEGRAM`.

activated.description: Whether an alert should be sent to this channel.

escalationType.description: Determines the type of escalation to use. Possible values are `RUN_BASED` and `TIME_BASED`. Defaults to `RUN_BASED`.

parallelRunFailureThreshold.description: Configuration for parallel run failure threshold.

reminders.description: Defines how often to send reminder notifications after the initial alert.

enabled.description: Whether parallel run failure threshold is enabled. Only applies if the check is scheduled for multiple locations in parallel. Defaults to `false`.

percentage.description: Percentage of runs that must fail to trigger alert. Possible values are `10`, `20`, `30`, `40`, `50`, `60`, `70`, `80`, `90` and `100`. Defaults to `10`.

amount.description: Number of reminder notifications to send. Possible values are `0` (disabled), `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5` and `100000` (unlimited). Defaults to `0`.

interval.description: Interval between reminder notifications in minutes. Possible values are `5`, `10`, `15` and `30`. Defaults to `5`.

failedRunThreshold.description: Send an alert notification after the given number of consecutive check runs have failed. Possible values are between `1` and `5`. Defaults to `1`.

minutesFailingThreshold.description: Send an alert notification after the check has been failing for the given amount of time (in minutes). Possible values are `5`, `10`, `15` and `30`. Defaults to `5`.

goal.description: The user or system outcome the check protects. Must be between `1` and `2000` characters, without leading or trailing whitespace.

mustPreserves.description: Guardrails an automatic repair must not weaken or bypass. Must contain at most `20` statements, each between `1` and `1000` characters, without leading or trailing whitespace.

requiredOutcomes.description: Observable outcomes the check must continue to prove. Must contain at most `20` statements, each between `1` and `1000` characters, without leading or trailing whitespace.

assertions.description: A request can have multiple assertions.

basicAuth.description: Set up HTTP basic authentication (username & password).

bodyType.description: The `Content-Type` header of the request. Possible values are `NONE`, `JSON`, `FORM`, `RAW` and `GRAPHQL`. Defaults to `NONE`.

followRedirects.description: Whether to follow HTTP redirects. Defaults to `true`.

headers.description: HTTP headers to send with the request, as a map of header names to values. The values are not sensitive and show in plan output. To keep a credential in a header out of plan output, take it from a variable declared with `sensitive = true` or wrap it in `sensitive(...)`.

ipFamily.description: IP Family to be used when executing the api check. Possible values are `IPv4` and `IPv6`. Defaults to `IPv4`.

method.description: The HTTP method to use for this API check. Possible values are `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `HEAD`, `DELETE` and `PATCH`. Defaults to `GET`.

queryParameters.description: Query parameters to add to the request URL, as a map of parameter names to values. The values are not sensitive and show in plan output. skipSsl.description: Whether to skip TLS certificate validation of the request. Defaults to `false`.

url.description: The URL to call. Must be between `1` and `2048` characters.

comparison.description: The type of comparison to be executed between expected and actual value of the assertion. Possible values are `EQUALS`, `NOT_EQUALS`, `HAS_KEY`, `NOT_HAS_KEY`, `HAS_VALUE`, `NOT_HAS_VALUE`, `IS_EMPTY`, `NOT_EMPTY`, `GREATER_THAN`, `LESS_THAN`, `CONTAINS`, `NOT_CONTAINS`, `IS_NULL` and `NOT_NULL`.

property.description: The property selecting the asserted value within the source: a JSONPath expression for `JSON_BODY`, a header name for `HEADERS`, or a regular expression for `TEXT_BODY` whose first capture group is asserted instead of the whole body. Not used for `STATUS_CODE` and `RESPONSE_TIME`.

source.description: The source of the asserted value. Possible values are `STATUS_CODE`, `JSON_BODY`, `HEADERS`, `TEXT_BODY` and `RESPONSE_TIME`.

target.description: The value to compare against, e.g. `200` for `STATUS_CODE` or a number of milliseconds for `RESPONSE_TIME`. Leave empty for comparisons that take no value, such as `IS_EMPTY` and `NOT_NULL`.

baseBackoffSeconds.description: The number of seconds to wait before the first retry attempt. Must be at least `0`. Defaults to `60`. Not available when `type` is `NO_RETRIES`.

maxDurationSeconds.description: The total amount of time to continue retrying the check/monitor, in seconds. Possible values are between `0` and `600`. Defaults to `600`. Available when `type` is `FIXED`, `LINEAR` or `EXPONENTIAL`.

maxRetries.description: The maximum number of times to retry the check/monitor. Possible values are between `1` and `10`. Defaults to `2`. Available when `type` is `FIXED`, `LINEAR` or `EXPONENTIAL`.

onlyOn.description: Apply the retry strategy only if the defined conditions match.

sameRegion.description: Whether retries should be run in the same region as the initial check/monitor run. Defaults to `true`. Not available when `type` is `NO_RETRIES`.

type.description: Determines which type of retry strategy to use. Possible values are `FIXED`, `LINEAR`, `EXPONENTIAL`, `SINGLE_RETRY` and `NO_RETRIES`.

networkError.description: When `true`, retry only if the cause of the failure is a network error. Defaults to `false`.

## Example Usage

## Import

The `pulumi import` command can be used, for example:

Import an existing client certificate using its ID.

The ID is returned by the Checkly API at GET /v1/client-certificates.

```sh
$ pulumi import checkly:index/clientCertificate:ClientCertificate example 49a1d5df-b89a-4998-a469-b1358e282ea5
```

certificate.description: The client certificate in PEM format.

host.description: The host domain that the certificate should be used for. Wildcards are supported, e.g. `*.acme.com`. Must be at most `255` characters.

passphrase.description: Passphrase for the private key. Must be at most `95` bytes.

path.description: Optional URL path prefix that limits the certificate to requests under that path, e.g. `/partner/api`. Matching is on whole path segments: `/partner` applies to `/partner` and `/partner/orders` but not to `/partnership`. Must start with `/` and must not be a bare `/`; a trailing `/` is ignored. The path must already be in the form the API stores: segments separated by single slashes, with no `.` or `..` segments, no whitespace, control characters, `?`, `#` or `\`, and with non-ASCII characters and the characters `"<>^`{}` percent-encoded, e.g. `%7B` for `{`. Must be at most `2048` characters. API checks and Multistep checks match on path; gRPC, SSL and TCP monitors only use certificates without a path. Omit it to use the certificate for every path on the host.

trustedCa.description: PEM formatted bundle of CA certificates that the client should trust. The bundle may contain many CA certificates.

Checkly status pages allow you to easily communicate the uptime and health of your applications and services to your customers. A v3 status page has no cards or services: its structure is managed with `checkly.StatusPageV3Component` resources, and incidents can be automated with `checkly.StatusPageV3AutomationRule` resources.
